svg.title: Carriage – exploded view
svg.text: Carriage LB-25-FL – exploded view along the rail axis (oblique projection, scale ≈ 1 : 0.31)
1 body on a dummy rail / mandrel
2 balls into the 4 loaded tracks + returns
The ball row above the body is drawn
pulled out (one of 4 rows): loaded part
under the body, return in the hole, 180°
